The penultimate event of the South African Surf Series takes place at Pollock Beach. This is one of the highlights of the WSL Africa tour and features a Women’s QS 3000, Men’s QS 1000 and Junior Men and Women’s QS 1000 rated events.

The Vic Bay Classic takes place in the winter months so expect the biggest swells and highest quality of surfing. Watch former CT contender fight for the win as the crowd cheers their local hero. The fight for the mens series winner gets even closer at this final event.

Our expedition begins in the Klopeinersee, a journey that leads us into two countries - Slovenia and Austria. We're going to meet people whom the cold, fog and snow in winter does not keep them away from spending every day at the water.
